original_input.problem_statement: Expense reimbursement is slow: claims pass through 2-3 manager approvals with no visibility into status, and Finance manually re-keys every claim into the accounting system, consuming hours of staff time each week.
target_users: Employees submitting expense claims, who currently have no visibility into where their claim is stuck
Approving managers in the 2-3 step approval chain
Finance Operations staff who manually re-key claims and chase approvers

competitor_matrix.name: Expensify
competitor_matrix.positioning_summary: Mainstream expense-management SaaS with receipt scanning and approval workflows
competitor_matrix.strengths_summary: Mature product, mobile receipt capture, broad accounting-system integrations
competitor_matrix.weaknesses_summary: Priced/featured for external expense management; heavier than needed for one approval chain.
competitor_matrix.reasoning: Directly relevant alternative for the stated approval-chain and re-keying problem; widely known in this category.

competitor_matrix.name: Manual spreadsheet + email tracking (status quo)
competitor_matrix.positioning_summary: The current internal process described in the input
competitor_matrix.strengths_summary: No new tooling cost, familiar to staff
competitor_matrix.weaknesses_summary: No employee visibility, no approver dashboard, manual Finance re-keying — the exact pain points.
competitor_matrix.reasoning: The status quo is itself the most relevant 'competitor' — the input describes it directly.

strengths.summary: A purpose-built tool can be scoped to this org's approval chain, unlike a general-purpose SaaS tool.
strengths.reasoning: Derived from CM-01's weakness (over-featured for this use case) — a narrower internal tool avoids that overhead.

weaknesses.summary: No existing internal tooling or team experience building approval-workflow software
weaknesses.reasoning: Inferred from the problem being currently solved manually (CM-02) — no internal precedent exists to build from.

opportunities.summary: Eliminating Finance's manual re-keying is a clear, measurable win the status quo doesn't offer.
opportunities.reasoning: Derived from CM-02's stated weakness (manual re-keying) being the input's most explicit pain point.

threats.summary: If Expensify (CM-01) is already budget-approved elsewhere, a bespoke tool may seem duplicative.
threats.reasoning: There is general competitive pressure in this space.

data_sufficiency.rationale_summary: Two alternatives reviewed — a mainstream SaaS leader and status-quo manual process — covering realistic options.
